title: A Alibi for the Ledger
author: Gideon Winterbourne
blurb: Orsen Joubert, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
